description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides an API function to fetch and normalize a summary of users by tenant from a backend endpoint. It imports an external function, getTenantUsersSummaryStrict, and exposes getTenantUsersSummary for use elsewhere.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary data from the backend, normalizes the response shape, and returns an object containing items and total count.
